title: Auto Painter
description:
Who are We?


Cars24 isn’t just a name; we’re a driving force in the pre-owned automobile industry, revolutionizing the way buyers get behind the wheel of their dream cars. From earning unicorn status in India to hitting the gas on our global expansion across the UAE and Australia, we’re all about turning the gears of innovation. Our secret? A dream team that leads with passion and drives with purpose.

Now, we’re revving up our team in the UAE and looking for talent ready to make our journey of progress their own. Buckle up, because the current pit stop is within our Operations function as a Multi-Brand Automotive Painter.

What Will You Be Doing in the Driver’s Seat?

  • Preparing vehicle surfaces through sanding, masking, and priming to ensure a flawless paint application.
  • Performing colour matching and spray painting across a variety of vehicle makes and models.
  • Carrying out polishing and finishing work to achieve showroom-quality results.
  • Inspecting completed jobs to ensure high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction.
  • Following workshop procedures, safety standards, and quality guidelines at all times.
  • Collaborating with the body shop and refurbishment teams to ensure timely vehicle readiness.

What’s Under the Hood?

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in automotive painting.
  • Strong expertise in sanding, masking, priming, colour matching, spray painting, and polishing.
  • Experience working on multiple vehicle brands and models.
  • A keen eye for detail and commitment to delivering high-quality finishes.
  • Knowledge of paint products, application techniques, and workshop safety practices.
  • GCC/UAE automotive workshop experience is preferred.

What’s in It for You?

  • Competitive remuneration that keeps pace with industry standards.
  • Benefits aligned with regional norms.
  • A workplace where craftsmanship is valued and quality takes center stage.
  • The opportunity to work with a fast-growing automotive brand that is transforming the used car industry.
  • A collaborative environment where your expertise helps keep our vehicles looking their absolute best.

title: Auto Denter
description:
Who are we?

Cars24 isn't just a name — we're a driving force in the pre-owned automobile industry, revolutionizing the way buyers get behind the wheel of their dream cars. From earning unicorn status in India to hitting the gas on our global expansion across the UAE and Australia, we're all about turning the gears of innovation. Our secret? A dream team that leads with passion and drives with purpose.

Now, we're revving up our team in the UAE and looking for talent ready to make our journey of progress their own. Buckle up — because the current pit stop is within the Refurbishment function, and we're hunting for a skilled Auto Denter ready to restore vehicles to showroom glory.

What would you do while you work with us?

  • Get panels back in shape — remove dents, dings, and damage using traditional panel beating, dollies, hammers, and PDR techniques.
  • Be the surgeon of the body shop — assess damage accurately and select the right repair method for every vehicle.
  • Smooth things over — apply body filler, sand, and feather surfaces so they're ready for a flawless paint finish.
  • Work at pit-stop pace — hit TAT targets without cutting corners on quality.
  • Keep the handover clean — complete job cards accurately and coordinate smoothly with the paint team.
  • Spot what others miss — flag hidden or additional damage during the repair process.
  • Keep your bay race-ready — maintain a safe, organised, and clean workspace at all times.

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience as a panel beater or auto denter.
  • Proficiency in both traditional panel beating and Paintless Dent Repair (PDR) techniques.
  • Experience in a volume or used-car refurbishment workshop is a strong advantage.
  • Vocational training or diploma in auto body repair or a related field — preferred.
  • Sharp eye for surface quality and detail — you'll notice what the camera misses.
  • Physically fit, team-oriented, and able to work under turnaround pressure without compromising standards.
  • UAE driving licence — preferred.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive remuneration as per current industry standards.
  • Benefits as per UAE regional norms — visa, medical insurance, and accommodation support (as applicable).
  • End-of-service benefits in line with UAE Labour Law.
  • A culture that gives you freedom to showcase your skills and grow within Cars24's expanding workshop network.
  • An opportunity to work alongside some of the best minds — and hands — in the industry.

title: Yard Coordinator | Sharjah
description:
Who are we?

Cars24 isn’t just a name; we’re a driving force in the pre-owned automobile industry, revolutionizing the way buyers get behind the wheel of their dream cars. From earning unicorn status in India to hitting the gas on our global expansion across the UAE and Australia, we’re all about turning the gears of innovation. Our secret? A dream team that leads with passion and drives with purpose.

Now, we’re revving up our team in the UAE and looking for talent ready to make our journey of progress their own. Buckle up, because the current pit stop is within the Operations function as a Yard Coordinator.

What Will You Be Doing in the Driver’s Seat?

  • Ensure all vehicles are prepared for delivery on time while maintaining Cars24’s cleaning and presentation standards.
  • Verify that all delivery-related documents are complete, accurate, and safely placed inside each vehicle before delivery.
  • Complete Delivery Quality Checks (QC) and ensure all required vehicle and document photos are uploaded to the designated system.
  • Maintain daily inventory cleaning and ensure the yard remains clean, organized, and operationally efficient.
  • Ensure every vehicle is fitted with the required Cars24 log plate, air freshener, key tag, and QR code sticker before delivery.
  • Conduct periodic SMT inspections and update findings accurately in the Refurb App.
  • Perform daily random post-movement audits to ensure compliance with operational processes and quality standards.
  • Coordinate with the Security team to ensure timely vehicle stock-in and stock-out activities, including completion of required checklists and photo documentation.
  • Ensure vehicles are assigned to the correct parking slots and that parking locations are accurately updated in the system and on the corresponding key tags.
  • Monitor delivery materials and yard consumables, ensuring they are safely stored, regularly tracked, and replenished on time.

What’s Under the Hood?

  • 2–3 years of experience in yard operations, fleet management, automotive operations, logistics, or a similar coordination role.
  • Experience in the automotive industry is highly preferred.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to coordinate vehicle movements efficiently.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining quality standards.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with inventory or operational management systems.
  • A proactive, reliable, and accountable approach to work.
  • A valid UAE driving license is preferred.

What’s in It for You?

  • Competitive remuneration that keeps pace with industry standards.
  • Benefits aligned with regional norms.
  • A workplace where your ideas matter and operational excellence is celebrated.
  • The opportunity to grow your career with one of the fastest-growing automotive technology companies in the region.
  • The chance to work alongside passionate professionals who are transforming the pre-owned car buying experience.

title: Junior Logistics Coordinator
description:

A dream team that leads with passion and drives with purpose.

Now, we’re revving up our team in the UAE and looking for talent ready to make our journey of progress their own. Buckle up, because the current pit stop is within the Operations function as a Junior Operations Coordinator.

What will you drive:
  • Communicate clearly and efficiently with drivers to ensure accurate pickup and delivery times.
  • Address any route changes, delays, or issues promptly to ensure seamless operations.
  • Manage relationships with fixed monthly outsource drivers responsible for transporting our vehicles.
  • Coordinate and schedule ad-hoc outsource drivers for additional transportation needs.
  • Oversee the movement of vehicles by coordinating with both fixed and ad-hoc drivers.
  • Ensure that vehicles are delivered to designated locations on time and in optimal condition.
  • Implement strategies to improve driver performance and maintain positive relationships.

What are we looking for?
  • Relevant experience in logistics coordination.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships with vendors, suppliers, and carriers within the automotive sector.

What’s in It for You?
  • The driver’s seat in a fast-growing company that’s accelerating towards success.
  • Competitive salary based on performance that keeps you fueled up for the ride.
  • A dynamic, cutting-edge work environment with tools that help you shift into top gear.
  • A team culture that feels like a pit crew – supportive, innovative, and always aiming for the win.
